release: UI109 — reusable log definitions and individual inventory review
implemented: Supported log table headings become reusable empty field definitions rather than checklists or imported completed log entries; bounded leading context is reviewed as guidance.
Recognized log field definitions omit the unrelated checklist-row warning while retaining other missing/ambiguous-definition guidance.
Toolbox discussion-topic tables retain supported topic wording while excluding completed attendee answers, names and signatures from reusable definitions.
Inventory import supports explicit corrections to individual incoming rows before approval, with retained source references and item identity boundaries; quantity zero and Unknown remain distinct.
Changes to an incoming item invalidate prior approval and require another check. Read-only inspection preserves approval, and pending or uncertain saves retain their original retry request.
Five served/offline Help topics include current instructions inside their content and outlines; the existing catalogue is regenerated from actual current articles with retained bookmark identifiers.
UI108 source review and Toolbox recovery, UI107 relationships, UI106 document review, UI105 inventory verification and UI94 navigation/art/profile layouts remain covered by unchanged retained suites.
